items.title: 8.15 Equilibrium par catalyst ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.15, printed page 182.

blocks.text: Catalyst woh substance hai jo khud kharch hue baghair chemical reaction ki rate barhata hai. Catalyst equilibrium ki position aur equilibrium constant nahi badalta. Yeh sirf equilibrium tak pohanchne ki raftar tez karta hai. Matlab reaction ki yield (hasil hone wali miqdar) wahi rehti hai.

Catalyst reaction ko kam activation energy wala naya rasta deta hai. Agar x-axis par reaction coordinate aur y-axis par potential energy le kar graph banayein, to catalyst ki maujoodgi mein curve ki chooti (maximum) neechi ho jati hai, jaise Figure 8.3 mein.

blocks.alt: Energy (y) ke muqable reaction coordinate (x). Do kohaan (hump) wale curves reactants ki satah se shuru ho kar products ki neechi satah par khatam hote hain. Ooncha curve (baghair catalyst) aur neecha curve (catalyst ke saath) dono ki chooti 'activated state' hai. Teer Ea (uncatalyzed reaction) reactants ki satah se oonchi chooti tak, teer E'a (catalyzed reaction) reactants ki satah se neechi chooti tak, aur ΔH reactants aur products ki satahon ke darmiyan.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: Reversible reactions par catalyst ka asar (kitab ki Figure 8.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Catalyst ek naya, neecha rasta deta hai: neeche wale curve ki chooti kam oonchi hai, is liye E'a, Ea se chhota hai. Reactants aur products ki satah wahi rehti hai, is liye ΔH nahi badalta aur equilibrium ki position bhi wahi rehti hai; sirf equilibrium jaldi aata hai. Kitab ki figure mein Ea ka teer products ki lakeer tak neeche chala gaya hai; activation energy reactants ki satah se napi jati hai, is liye hamari drawing mein Ea ka teer reactants ki lakeer se chooti tak hai.

blocks.prompt: Contact process mein SO₂ aur O₂ ke mixture mein V₂O₅ dalne se SO₃ bohat tez banti hai. Kya is se SO₃ ki equilibrium yield barhti hai?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Catalyst forward aur reverse dono reactions ki activation energy barabar kam karta hai, is liye equilibrium jaldi aata hai magar usi position par; yield aur Kp wahi rehte hain. Yield sirf temperature, pressure ya concentrations badal kar barhai ja sakti hai.

items: Catalyst dono taraf Ea kam kar ke equilibrium jaldi lata hai.
Position, equilibrium constant aur yield nahi badalte (Figure 8.3).
